external_baseline_enrichment.note: baseline is an external literature approximation; enrichment DIRECTION is robust, exact factor is prior-dependent. The internal_control block is fully self-contained and decisive.

interpretation: Anomaly-selected SDSS QSOs are strongly high-z-enriched (67.3% at z>2, 198 at z>6) and the anomaly score is significantly higher for z>4 QSOs than z<=4 QSOs (Mann-Whitney p=1.05e-103; Spearman rho=+0.036, p=9.6e-19). This is a real astrophysical selection signal: the detector preferentially ranks genuinely rare high-z quasars, which sky-fiber / calibration noise cannot produce. Directly rebuts RS24 ChatGPT §III A/B and Grok §IV A.
